name: history-record-integrity
goal: Reject inherited-state relabeling and every mismatched verification note identity consistently

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Reject relabeled inherited states/captures and note tree, base, profile or finish-time mismatches in both readers.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: The unchanged new lineage regression fails against 697023c (one failure, five controls): /tmp/harness-core-inherited-states-durable-red.log. Sealed in-memory fixtures also expose local note mismatches.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Compare inherited states and capture bindings with the tested origin; both readers share the eight-field verificationNoteIdentity guard.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Seven durable lineage/identity tests pass: /tmp/harness-core-integrity-green.log. Both actual readers reject the same sealed mutations: /tmp/harness-core-integrity-green.json.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
